name: Majo
summary: Majo is an apocalyptic witch-cultivation strategy RPG featuring a surreal suspense and bizarre style. In the modern, eerie world of Majo, the senses and minds of all humanity have long been manipulated by a mysterious, higher-dimensional force that transcends human comprehension. To prevent the world from perceiving the truth, 'It' appropriated memory fragments from parallel dimensions and combined them with fabricated responses, disguising reality as the 'dreams, intuition, and sixth sense' that the masses accept without question.
